Dyad is a free, local, open-source AI app builder
What's Changed
- Fix CI GitHub auth, Windows lock coverage, and dependency warmups by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4990
- Add Windows compatibility PR reviewer with code execution by @wwwillchen in #4995
- Allow maintainers to request Claude reviews on any PR by @wwwillchen in #4996
- fix(agent): skip todo follow-up after turn limits by @RyanGroch in #4999
- Fix Windows PR reviewer checkout and narrow execution allowlist by @wwwillchen in #5001
- Recover MCP and ChatGPT credentials across macOS Keychain identities by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4976
- feat(neon): report failed Neon branch creates and deletes by @RyanGroch in #4998
- feat(telemetry): report filesystem failures that are only logged or shown by @RyanGroch in #5003
- fix(agent): stop safety review replaying item IDs by @RyanGroch in #5023
- fix(agent): stream compaction summary as patches, not full history by @RyanGroch in #5021
- fix(neon): classify getProject errors instead of rethrowing the raw SDK error by @azizmejri1 in #5014
- Cap execGit output so oversized git output can't crash the main process by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4994
- feat(telemetry): upload source maps to PostHog by @RyanGroch in #5008
- Show active subscription badges in the model picker by @wwwillchen in #5002
- Bump to v1.24.0-beta.1 by @wwwillchen in #5025
- Stabilize E2E interactions during app startup and navigation by @keppo-bot[bot] in #5028
- Fix Claude installation in Windows PR reviews by @wwwillchen in #5032
- Migrate remaining application requests off node-fetch by @keppo-bot[bot] in #5031
- feat(telemetry): report unexpected state machine failures by @RyanGroch in #5006
- fix(chat): preserve unsent composer drafts across app restarts by @orev7s in #4969
- Fetch models from custom provider endpoints by @weecee0 in #4971
- Keep macOS signing keychain unlocked during release builds by @wwwillchen in #5047
- Prepare clipboard and packaging for Electron 44 and 45 by @keppo-bot[bot] in #5030
- Move E2E test directory cleanup into a background queue by @azizmejri1 in #5040
- fix: recover Neon authentication with reconnect prompts by @azizmejri1 in #5016
- fix(chat): don't query another app's repo for the modified-files card by @RyanGroch in #5045
- test: fix Neon reconnect test failures on main by @azizmejri1 in #5051
- feat(plugins): app-specific plugin configurations (experiment) by @RyanGroch in #5050
- Bump to v1.24.0-beta.2 by @wwwillchen in #5053
- fix(plugins): stop sending prompt=select_account on OAuth sign-in by @RyanGroch in #5057
- Promote v1.24.0-beta.2 to v1.24.0 by @wwwillchen in #5071
New Contributors
- @orev7s made their first contribution in #4969
- @weecee0 made their first contribution in #4971
Full Changelog: v1.23.0...v1.24.0
